fields.description: Decides how values are normalised before comparing.

fields.label: Match Role
fields.description: Unique Identifier: an exact match is a strong match. Name: a match alone is only possible. Shared: phone/email that legitimate records may share.

fields.label: Source
fields.description: Linked Contact: also looks at the Contacts linked to Customers/Suppliers.

fields.label: Child Table
fields.description: Table fieldname on the DocType, e.g. barcodes.

fields.label: Group
fields.description: Fields sharing a group must ALL match to count as one identifier (e.g. Supplier + Supplier Invoice No).

fields.label: Excluded
fields.description: Kept in the rule but ignored while matching.
